title: パワフル最強シンデレラ！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I am the prince of this kingdom.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Luxurious parties continue day and night within my castle. These events are the height of extravagance and see me fed with only the most lavish of meals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And yet, I am dissatisfied with this lifestyle. Is there nothing that can help me break free from this dreary monotony?
BAM!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All of a sudden, one of the castle's outer walls crumbles! The dust clears to reveal a lone girl standing atop the debris!
I've finally arrived at the kingdom's castle! My, it's so brilliant and dazzling and beautiful!
This is a castle truly fit for one such as myself!
Oh my! I take it that you're the prince? Oh, how I've yearned to meet you! You are quite literally the prince of my dreams!
Allow me to introduce myself. I am the one and only…

text_block_list.name: Cinderella
text_block_list.text: Cinderella!

text_block_list.name: Cinderella's Stepmother
text_block_list.text: C-Cinderella?! What are you doing here?!

text_block_list.name: Cinderella's Stepsister
text_block_list.text: But we left you behind at the manor!

text_block_list.name: Cinderella
text_block_list.text: I ran a hundred kilometers to get here!

text_block_list.name: Cinderella
text_block_list.text: I climbed mountains, leapt across valleys, shattered boulders, swam through raging rapids…

text_block_list.name: Cinderella
text_block_list.text: And after overcoming a series of misfortunes, I've finally arrived at the party I've long awaited!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I still don't quite understand what's going on, but this girl seems pretty amazing.
Wheeze… Wheeze… H-hey! Cinderella! Wait right there!

text_block_list.name: Cinderella
text_block_list.text: Oh? Who might you be?
Pant… Phew… H-hang on a second… I need some water… We had to run all this way, too, you know?
Gulp, gulp… Ahhh! Okay! Prepare to have your mind blown, Cinderella! For I am…

text_block_list.name: The Sorceress
text_block_list.text: The Sorceress!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wait, did this "sorceress" also run a hundred kilometers to get here?!
That's… not all! Wheeze… Huff… There's me—wheeze—and…

text_block_list.name: Vodka the Fairy
text_block_list.text: M-me, the sorceress's… wheeze, wheeze… fairies! Pant… Phew!

text_block_list.name: The Sorceress
text_block_list.text: Cinderella! You came all this way on your own? And just when I was about to assist you with my wondrous magic!

text_block_list.name: The Sorceress
text_block_list.text: I guess you won't be needing that pumpkin carriage. Or a magical device to help you cross those treacherous mountains. Hmm… What's left that you need?

text_block_list.name: Scarlet the Fairy
text_block_list.text: Sorceress! I think she could use an elegant dress befitting this lavish party!

text_block_list.name: Vodka the Fairy
text_block_list.text: Wrong, Scarlet! What she needs is a pair of glass slippers! Some really sweet and stylish ones!

text_block_list.name: Scarlet the Fairy
text_block_list.text: Oh, what do you know?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka the Fairy
text_block_list.text: Say what?!
choice_data_list: You two sure get on well.
You two sure get on well.

text_block_list.name: The Two Fairies
text_block_list.text: Do not!

text_block_list.name: Cinderella
text_block_list.text: What do you think, my prince? A beautiful dress or glass slippers, which should I choose?
choice_data_list: I think you're perfect just the way you are.
I think you're perfect just the way you are.
You should accentuate your strong points!

text_block_list.name: The Sorceress
text_block_list.text: Huhhh?! You mean you don't want either?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: True beauty has nothing to do with your appearance. I tell Cinderella what really counts is your heart and how you show it.

text_block_list.name: Cinderella
text_block_list.text: I see! It's just like my beloved Princess Fighter said! "You shouldn't judge people based on how they look!"

text_block_list.name: Cinderella
text_block_list.text: So, basically… what you're saying is that I'm already a princess, right?!
choice_data_list: You're the very definition of a princess!
You're the very definition of a princess!

text_block_list.name: Cinderella
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! I'm as princess as can be!

text_block_list.name: The Sorceress
text_block_list.text: Geez! Then what did we come all this way for?! I don't get you people!

text_block_list.name: Cinderella
text_block_list.text: Huh?! My strong points?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She ran a hundred kilometers over perilous terrain. That kind of powerful physical ability is remarkable. She has limitless potential!
choice_data_list: Join me and pursue a career as an athlete!
Join me and pursue a career as an athlete!

text_block_list.name: Cinderella
text_block_list.text: Me? An athlete?!

text_block_list.name: Cinderella
text_block_list.text: Th-then… the thing I should ask the sorceress for is…

text_block_list.name: Cinderella
text_block_list.text: A pair of training shoes!

text_block_list.name: The Sorceress
text_block_list.text: Come ooon, you don't need magic to get training shoes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Beep-beep-beep! Beep-beep-beep!
choice_data_list: Wha?! …Oh, it was all a dream.
